tools.name: connectMcpServer
tools.description: Get the MCP server endpoint URL for a specific Google Workspace product so an AI agent can connect to it. Returns the Streamable HTTP endpoint and authentication instructions.

product.description: The Google Workspace product to connect to.

tools.name: openDocs
tools.description: Open the GPT Workspace documentation to learn how to install or use GPT Workspace features in Google Docs, Gmail, Sheets, Slides, or Drive.

section.description: The product section to navigate to. One of: docs, gmail, sheets, slides, drive, gpts, blog, chrome.

tools.name: startFreeTrial
tools.description: Open the GPT Workspace sign-up or install page so the user can start a free trial. Useful when the user asks how to get started or try the product.
